description: Defines the ErrorResponse class for handling API error responses, including exception details and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: A class representing an error response in a JSON API, capable of serializing error details and exception information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes ErrorResponse, setting debug mode based on ApiConfig or parameter.

methods.name: setException
methods.description: Associates an Exception object with the error response.

methods.name: getExceptionArray
methods.description: Returns exception details as an array, or null if no exception.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the error response to JSON, including exception details if in debug mode.
